issues.description: The type of Note.creationDate is inconsistent between artifacts. The problem statement and the template repository's common/model/Note.java use java.time.Instant for creationDate (the curl example and server NoteService in the template also expect an Instant). In the solution repository the common Note model declares creationDate as a String, while the solution server's NoteService still sets creationDate using Instant.now(). This mismatch (Instant vs String) is a structural type inconsistency that will cause compilation errors and confusion about the intended model type and JSON serialization format.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep the Note.creationDate type consistent across all modules. Preferably revert the solution repository's common/model/Note.creationDate back to java.time.Instant (matching the problem statement and the template). Ensure NoteService continues to set creationDate with Instant.now() and that client/server JSON (de)serialization is configured to handle Instant (or explicitly convert to/from ISO-8601 strings at the API boundary). Alternatively, if a String representation is desired, update NoteService to set creationDate using Instant.now().toString() and update all usages and documentation to reflect the String type — but do this consistently across common, client, and server modules.
